The brand 'POLARIS' is clearly printed at the top left of the box.
The model number 'SP-6342' is visible at the bottom center of the box.
The box indicates features such as 3.1 X-BASS, Bluetooth, FM Radio, and MP3 support.
The top right corner of the box is dented and shows signs of wear/compression.
The actual electronic components (subwoofer and satellite speakers) are not visible, only their depiction on the box.

risks.proof: A photo of the actual speakers and subwoofer outside of the box.

risks.risk: The unit may be used or have physical damage not visible from the box.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the actual unit from multiple angles.

risks.risk: The system may be non-functional or missing the remote and cables.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual speakers and subwoofer out of the box.
A video of the system powered on and playing music to confirm functionality.
Photos of the remote control and all included cables.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the packaging, allowing the item to be priced at its worst-case value (used/non-functional) until the contents and condition are verified.
